name: phi-spaces-codemode-chat
description: Next.js 16 + React 19 codemode chat: agents and people contribute code to a phi-space, judged in a codemode sandbox

scripts.docker:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test run --rm --build codemode-chat-test
scripts.docker:dev:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev up -d --build codemode-chat-dev
scripts.docker:dev:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev logs -f codemode-chat-dev
scripts.docker:nano:build: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano build codemode-nano
scripts.docker:nano:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano up -d --build codemode-nano
scripts.docker:nano:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano logs -f codemode-nano
